statement: Flow is quasi-steady within each integration substep
Water density 1000 kg/m3 and g = 9.80665 m/s2
Quadratic pump curve H = H0*s^2 - k*Q^2 with affinity-law speed scaling
Efficiency is parabolic around the rated point (floor 20 %)
Darcy-Weisbach losses with a constant friction factor per pipe
Kv sizing with a linear trim; 0 % opening blocks the flow
Check valves prevent reverse flow on every transfer
Vertical walls (volume = area x level); overflow above capacity is lost
Pumps start/stop on destination level at telemetry boundaries
Gravity and inlet control valves modulate on level every substep
Diurnal demand profile with one harmonic per outlet
Flow and pressure are interval means; level is the interval-end value
Gaussian sensor noise; meters read 0 below the low-flow cut-off
Leaks occur downstream of the transfer flow meter and scale with flow
